name: bolivia_from_scratch
description: The published from-scratch TS-DDR training schedule: random initialisation, then three phases, each restarting from the policy the previous phase selected. Every setting below is the one the published policy was trained with. A fourth phase was attempted during the original search, produced no selectable policy, and is not listed: this file declares the schedule to REPRODUCE, not the search that found it.

stages.comment: From random initialisation. nt is held low and the learning rate high: on the repaired gradient this is the fastest descent regime, and starting at a high nt is flat. Rollout evaluation is pooled here because the stage has no parent value to reproduce.

Same sampling and learning-rate band, restarted from the previous phase's selected policy. A restart resets Adam, the cosine phase and the warm-up, which is the point: the stage is a fresh descent from a better initialisation, not a continuation.

The convergence stage: nt is raised and the learning rate dropped an order of magnitude, so the gradient is precise and the step small. Rollout evaluation is SEQUENTIAL — this is the stage whose checkpoint is published, and the sequential path is the one whose reproducibility is established.
